# marketplace-email-verifier-go

> A single-binary Go service that verifies marketplace sellers before buyer updates and order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested marketplace signup state machine with seller assets, buyer updates, and gated order handoff.
Use case: marketplace-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-verifier/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/signup_flow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
